name: Tidewave (nshafer)
description: Installs the Tidewave CLI at build time and starts it on every container start, so the Tidewave app on the host can drive the project inside the container.

version.description: Version to install: 'latest', or an exact X.Y.Z matching a tidewave_app release tag.

port.description: Port the CLI listens on inside the container. It has to be published to the identical port number on the host -- the CLI rejects a request whose Origin names a different port -- so add "appPort": ["127.0.0.1:9000:9000"] to devcontainer.json.

allowRemoteAccess.description: Pass --allow-remote-access, which binds 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1. Required for a published port to reach it: Docker forwards to the container's bridge address, not to its loopback. The CLI still rejects requests whose Origin is not localhost.

debug.description: Pass --debug, which makes the CLI log what it does to /tmp/tidewave.log. Off by default, because a healthy run is silent and the log is only read when something failed.

autostart.description: Start the CLI at postStart. Turn off to install the binary only and run 'tidewave' yourself.
